goal: Complete and verify every actionable Palumbo request from today's VII review across homepage, search and management controls.

intent_model.literal_request: Take care of everything Palumbo requested and ask Adir only about genuinely unclear items.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A coherent, production-ready VII experience in which none of Palumbo's actionable feedback is silently omitted or falsely marked complete.
likely_rejections: A control exists but is not manageable or does not persist.
The code changed but the public site was not verified.
Mobile or a related component family regressed.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Use the complete reviewed message inventory, not a representative sample.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Every actionable item has an explicit requirement and natural-surface evidence.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Visitors see visual, immediately understandable discovery and search controls.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose one discovery category, date intent or filter at a time.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open matching results or a place without waiting for an unexplained state.

natural_destination: Public VII homepage and vacation search, plus authenticated content studio

facts.claim: Ten message-level requests were previously verified and fifteen remained partial, unclear or non-actionable.
The current public release is version 417 from source baa414c.
facts.evidence: Prior live release verification in the active VII task.

assumptions.claim: The 19:17 voice note is not an actionable product requirement until its content is available.
assumptions.validation: Ask Adir only if the written requirements are completed and the voice note remains unavailable.

in_scope: Complete live-deal contact and card facts
Holiday tab presentation without public dates
Missing homepage discovery, video and editorial sections
Complete sort labels, automatic result loading and filter naming
Preserve already verified map and card fixes
Publish and verify the exact production release
out_of_scope: Outbound WhatsApp replies before action-time sender confirmation
invariants: Supplier availability and approved catalog data remain the source of truth.
Map stickiness and card-marker synchronization remain working.
Published content remains versioned and authorized.
Search URL, breadcrumbs, H1, filters, count, list and map remain coherent.
The modern Hebrew Heebo stack remains consistent.

requirements.statement: Popular searches are visual, aligned, managed and provide immediate navigation feedback.
Live-deal cards expose all requested facts plus phone and WhatsApp without redundant booking copy.
Holiday tabs show at most six managed holidays without public date text.
Homepage includes the requested popular search, city, accommodation-type, video and editorial discovery sections after recommended destinations.
Vacation location discovery uses the full available hierarchy ordered regions, subregions, cities and matching places.
The calendar sentence identified by Palumbo is removed.
Flexible-date search is self-explanatory before and after selection.
Vacation sorting includes price directions and the requested alphabetic label.
Vacation results load automatically on scroll without requiring repeated show-more clicks.
The unclear additional-filter label is replaced by an explicit category while retaining price and accommodation filters.
All changed management controls persist after save and reload and affect the published homepage only after publication.
The exact released version passes build, focused tests, typography, desktop, mobile and affected-family regression checks.

acceptance_checks.action: Inspect and activate each popular-search card.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each item has a visual anchor and managed label, acknowledges activation and opens its exact result state.

acceptance_checks.setup: A deal has verified phone and WhatsApp data.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect the card and activate each contact method.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Facts, one-night wording, included guests, direct phone and prepared WhatsApp actions are visible and distinct.
At most six visible holiday tabs retain managed order and visibility, and no tab prints its date.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open homepage with representative catalog data.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every requested discovery section is visible, populated with verified data and has working navigation.
Regions precede subregions, then cities and matching places, with no unrelated fallback.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the home calendar and flexible-date search.
acceptance_checks.action: Review instructions and complete a flexible selection.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The removed sentence is absent and the flexible flow explains its behavior and resulting date window.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open vacation results with prices and types.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Price directions, alphabetic A-to-Z wording, accommodation types, price range and an explicit feature-filter label are available.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open a result set longer than the initial window.
acceptance_checks.action: Scroll near the end of the visible results.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The next window loads automatically with accessible progress and no duplicate cards.

acceptance_checks.setup: A CMS save or publish request fails.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The initiating control exits loading, shows a clear error and does not falsely alter the public configuration.

acceptance_checks.setup: The candidate build is available with a known previous production version.
acceptance_checks.action: Run affected-family verification and deploy only after pass.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The new version works on desktop and 390px mobile, with a documented rollback identity.

open_questions.question: What exactly was said in the 19:17 voice note?
open_questions.resolution: Treat it as outside the written requirement inventory unless Adir supplies the content.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, testing and publication are authorized. Sending WhatsApp replies remains separately confirmation-gated.
